in_latin.name: Concepcio
in_latin.meaning: Conceptio, conceptus, concepit, conceptus, concepere, concepit, conceptus, conceptio
in_latin.long_meaning: Conceptio, conceptus, concepit, conceptus, concepere, concepit, conceptus, conceptio. Concepcio est nomen femininum, quod significat conceptio fetalis et creatio mundi. In litteratura Christiana, Concepcio refert ad creaturam et generationem Christi, quae concepta est in utero Virginis Mariae. Conceptio est conceptus, quae significat initium creationis et novae vitae. Per concepcionem, Deus creavit mundum et vitam, et per hanc conceptus, conceptio, et concepcionem, Deus creavit hominem et creaturam suam, et conceptus et conceptio significat creaturam et generationem Christi.

in_english.name: Concepcion
in_english.meaning: Concept of conception, creation, and birth of a new life
in_english.long_meaning: Concepcion is a Christian name that conveys the concept of conception, creation, and birth of a new life. It originates from the Latin word 'conceptio,' meaning conception or creation, and is associated with the biblical account of the conception and birth of Jesus Christ. Concepcion is a name that reflects the Christian values of creation, life, and the miracle of birth. In Christian tradition, Concepcion is often linked to the Immaculate Conception of the Virgin Mary, emphasizing the idea of a pure and sinless conception. The name Concepcion is also associated with the concept of new beginnings, renewal, and the promise of a new life. It is a name that inspires hope, faith, and the celebration of life.
